claim: The DataSync user guide says Enhanced mode is currently for transfers between Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx for OpenZFS, NFS, SMB, HDFS, Azure Blob and object storage (including other clouds) locations, some of which require an Enhanced mode agent, while Basic mode supports all locations DataSync supports.
question: Which locations does DataSync Enhanced mode support according to the user guide?

values.display: Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx for OpenZFS

qualifiers.scope: AWS DataSync Enhanced mode, user guide wording
qualifiers.condition: some of these transfers require an Enhanced mode agent

note: Conflicts with the DataSync FAQ (datasync-faq-enhanced-mode-locations-as-of-faq), which names only S3, other clouds and on-premises NFS or SMB with S3. The guide is newer: Enhanced mode for EFS, FSx for Lustre, HDFS, Azure Blob and object storage was announced on 2026-07-28 and is not examinable yet.
